notes.title: Lincoln swears in! Patch 9.1.2025
notes.content:
[h1]New Character Alert![/h1][p]Synonymous with freedom, unity, and America as an idea, Abraham Lincoln makes his presence known with an off-beat playstyle, unique movement options, and giant hitboxes.[/p][h2]BIG moves[/h2][p]At 6'4, Lincoln was the tallest president in American history. We decided that wasn't tall enough. Lincoln is twice the size of some of our fighters and he's got the special moves to match.[/p][h3]Neutral Special: Hat throw[/h3][p]Lincoln's neutral special is a simple projectile with a short travel time. While it might seem unimpressive at first, it can be charged over time, transforming it into a veritable full-screen laser.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/4fab13beeb61eeadec0c624138aa54840bd07ef8.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Side Special: Charge + Proclamation Punch[/h3][p]As our resident heavy (at least for now), Lincoln has the slowest move speed out of the current roster. However he makes up for it with his side special: Charge. After a short delay, Lincoln will launch forward with impressive speed. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/e9a1ea9a9c7623e67233fc14a49d24a524ffac45.gif"][/img][/p][p]But what's even more impressive is the charge's follow up, a massive dash punch that has [u]projectile invulnerability.[/u] That's right, you can run right at a zoner without worrying about any of those annoying fireballs. You can thank us later.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/7086b39425dc125888619f995b8dbc65f1b36fc6.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Up Special: Log Spin[/h3][p]Lincoln rounds out his bag of tricks with a massive spinning attack that makes use of his eponymous log. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/f7ff98a165422e90a931685286806f19ee2156d5.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Anything but honest...[/h2][p]If there's one move that defines our rendition of Lincoln, it's his unique ability "Lucky Penny." This move is on a four second cool down, and upon activation Lincoln will flip a penny into the air. The penny has no hitbox, but after a second, you'll be teleported to the penny's location, preserving your animation before the teleport.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/c8f5fd7b1ee657830b58eded98d89b5219a9408b.gif"][/img][/p][p]You can aim the coin with the control stick, or input the coin with no direction to automatically lock-on to your opponent's location. Oh and did we mention that you teleport with an extra active hitbox? We put everything into this move.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/f9514a5ff8bd2ce66bbf10fb0366b9ff161a61b9.gif"][/img][/p][p]And if that wasn't enough, pressing the input again will cancel the teleport allowing you to mix up your movement and subject your opponents to tricky mind games![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/e0f01e064ec2ba8b847a4a2267f3fec0a494f857.gif"][/img][/p][h2]...Enshrined Forever[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/db4f8d9326260cac89dd9fb75c15a59b72d7f188.gif"][/img][/p][p]Lincoln's super is a blink-and-you'll-miss-it transformation that obliterates any foes unfortunate enough to be trapped beneath it. Punish opponents foolish enough to get too close, or throw yourself through the air and carry your momentum for a full screen punish! It's also the perfect move to initiate out of a teleport, allowing you to get creative and finish off your enemies with style! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/9fc95af56844bc63693a2ef7da80b672af6977a1.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Other features: Two Players, One Keyboard[/h2][p]The game now supports two players playing on the same keyboard. While a controller is always still recommended (many keyboards can't handle inputs from two players at once), the option will now be available for anyone attempting to play locally with a single keyboard.[/p][h2]What's next?[/h2][p]Character six is fully drawn, but it'll be a bit before we have him coded. In the meantime, we'll likely drop a smaller update with some qol features and maybe a few gameplay modifications for existing characters (no promises there though). We may also take a week or two off to make some more social media content for the game, so make sure you give us a follow if you haven't to help us grow.[/p][p][/p][p]Until then, enjoy the newly expanded roster, thanks for the support and God Bless America.[/p]

notes.title: SPEED UP! Patch 7.17.2025
notes.content:
[h1]Obama Picks Up The Pace[/h1][h3]The Speeeeed![/h3][p]Obama has a new move! Press Special 2 (right trigger by default) to channel your ki into a speed boost![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/b2f1f6f5d1661a680289223e546f8b57e319d421.gif"][/img][/p][p]Upon activation, Obama's max speed is increased by 66% for two seconds, giving him downright oppressive grounded and aerial presence.[/p][p]Like Washington's shotgun, this speed boost is on a cooldown (8 seconds). [/p][h3]The Cancel[/h3][p]Speed isn't the only thing this new move does. It also lets you cancel the endlag of [u]any move.[/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/4fbe003696cd641954d6c7613fcf75246a82dfb8.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/d860ff8ef17d4ebfcb6051fb975c98f4fee9268b.gif"][/img][/p][p]This not only makes his options safer, it allows you to preserve your momentum from your up-special, leading to explosive new movement techniques. Get creative and dominate your opponents with stylish outplays![/p][h1]New Mechanic: Turnarounds[/h1][p]Fans of Super Smash Brothers Melee will be familiar with this one. All characters can now switch the direction of their attacks during a jump by quickly flicking the stick in the opposite direction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636198/b888bb30c7d69760f6390c2e8803b25bb014d339.gif"][/img]  [/p][p]It takes a bit getting used to, but it ultimately allows for vastly superior control over crucial tools like Washington's blunderbuss and Obama's fireball (since Obama Kick has been moved to side-special).[/p][h1]Balance Updates[/h1][p]This update's changes have shifted the power level of some of the cast, and we've also had a lot more time to gather informal data from playtesters. We've tried to target the most egregious moves in this patch to balance options we felt were over-centralizing or over-powered. [/p][h3]Obama[/h3][p]Our design philosophy for Obama has always been to make a forgiving character for beginners who's biggest strength is his super. As we add more characters, we still want Obamahameha to remain one of the best supers in the game, but with the buffs he received to the rest of his kit this patch, we felt like it might be time to reign it in (if only slightly). [/p][p]We also made the decision to increase the endlag on Teddy and Obama's uppercuts to make them easier to punish.[/p][list][*][p]New move: Speed up![/p][/*][*][p]Obama Kick input moved to side-special[/p][/*][*][p]Obamahameha super startup increased very slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Obama Punch endlag increased [/p][/*][/list][h3]Washington[/h3][p]We feel like Washington is one of our best executed characters, but he's also the character who benefits the most from the addition of turnaround specials. We've nerfed the effectiveness of his neutral special to compensate.[/p][p]Additionally, we felt as though his blunderbuss into super combo was a bit to consistent for a finisher that only costs 5 super charge. We've increased the startup (before the super flash) to make the combo harder to hit, but we're aware that it may still be too strong. We'll have our eye on this going forward.[/p][list][*][p]Blunderbuss stun duration lowered[/p][/*][*][p]Super start up increased.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Teddy[/h3][p]Teddy is intended to be a frame data monster, but right now his command inputs are so good we see no reason to use a regular punch (even when close range). Hopefully these changes will make playing him feel a bit more intentional.[/p][list][*][p]Uppercut endlag increased[/p][/*][*][p]Ground slam endlag increased[/p][/*][*][p]Ground slam can now be used on the ground with a down special input (it's not very good, and I kinda made it on accident, but I left it in cuz it's fun).[/p][/*][/list][h3]JFK[/h3][p]Jfk has not been changed as he is literally perfect.[/p][p][/p][h1]What's Next?[/h1][p]Lincoln is well on his way to being release-ready, and our artist has already started spritework on president #6 (no spoilers). If you want to stay up to date with the development (and maybe check out some pre-release content), join our discord for updates and more!

That's all for this update. Thanks for playing, and God Bless America.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 7.11.2025
notes.content:
[p]WHAT'S NEXT:[/p][p]We're really pumped to see all the positive reception for our first demo. It's super encouraging. Thanks so much to everyone leaving reviews.[/p][p][/p][p]We've got some exciting stuff on the way, but for today we just have a small patch and a few miscellaneous updates. [/p][p]
DISCORD[/p][p]-We made a discord! Drop by and say hi: [url="https://discord.gg/wmuGcdMCN8"]https://discord.gg/wmuGcdMCN8[/url]
[/p][p]QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES:[/p][p]-JFK's non-lethal super (the one that plays when you hit obama) is now skippable.[/p][p][/p][p]BUG FIXES:[/p][p]-Washington's AI now properly uses the bite attack on hit.[/p][p]-Fixed bugs related to mashing the start button after round completion.[/p][p][/p][p]WHAT'S NEXT[/p][p]We've been experimenting with an Obama rework that will likely go live this weekend (just need to playtest it for a bit). After that, we'll start working on our next full character (Lincoln).[/p][p][/p]
